mintAuthority.summary: sBOLD is a K3 Capital ERC-4626 wrapper over BOLD; wrapper issuance is share/risk-module accounting while durable BOLD mint authority is inherited from reviewed parent BOLD, and K3 wrapper administration resolves to a 2/3 Safe.

controls.label: sBOLD wrapper token
controls.evidence: Local metadata marks sBOLD as `variantOf: bold-liquity` and `variantKind: risk-absorption`; parent BOLD has reviewed `none-resolved` mint authority. At Ethereum block 25573280, asset() returned BOLD and EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were all zero. Share issuance remains the wrapper's deposit/accounting path, not a durable BOLD issuer mint surface.

controls.label: K3 sBOLD owner Safe
controls.capDescription: Owner-only fee switch on the wrapper: setFees can raise the deposit entry fee to 500 bps and the swap fee on collateral-to-BOLD conversions to 250 bps, with fees paid in BOLD to an owner-settable vault address; all fee rates read 0 at Ethereum block 26227575 (2026-10-19).

sources.label: K3 sBOLD BaseSBold.sol fee setters (commit a5fe08f)
K3 sBOLD fee maxima constants (commit a5fe08f)

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573280, getOwners() returned the listed three EOAs, getThreshold() returned 2, and getModulesPaginated() returned an empty list. Safe Transaction Service data reports a zero guard and the fallback handler 0xf48f2b2d2a534e402487b3ee7c18c33aec0fe5e4. Live ERC-4626 asset() also resolves to BOLD at 0x6440f144b7e50d6a8439336510312d2f54beb01d. Fee switch: BaseSBold source gives the owner onlyOwner setFees (entry fee capped at 500 bps by BPS_MAX_DEPOSIT_FEE, swap fee capped at 250 bps by BPS_MAX_FEE), setReward (swap-caller reward capped at 250 bps), and setVault (fee recipient); all three selectors are present in the deployed wrapper bytecode. At Ethereum block 26227575 (2026-10-19), feeBps(), swapFeeBps() and rewardBps() returned 0, and owner() and vault() both returned this Safe.

review.evidence: sBOLD inherits BOLD's reviewed mint authority for base BOLD creation. At Ethereum block 25573280, the direct wrapper contract had zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots; its owner Safe was 2-of-3 with no modules detected. There is no separately upgradeable wrapper mint-logic path.
